articles.summary: Innovation Showroom will feature solutions spanning power generation, energy storage, power conversion, and new lifecycle services Nextpower™ (Nasdaq: NXT), a leading provider of clean power generation and energy storage solutions, will introduce new lifecycle services and showcase a series of product and commercial milestones across solar generation, power collection and conversion, and energy storage at RE+ 2026. Nextpower’s integrated medium-voltage (MV) power conversion platform for utility-scale solar, storage, and hybrid projects. One year after becoming Nextpower (formerly Nextracker), the company will demonstrate how its solutions support modern energy infrastructure, from utility-scale power plants to behind-the-meter power systems. articles.title: Nextpower to Showcase Expanded Power Technology and Services Platform at RE+ 2026
